correctness.rationale: For a complete biclique all vertices on a shore see only the opposite shore occupied palette. The seven nonempty palette masks per shore form an exact 49-state factor for any sizes; updates on each present color are defined by the actual distinct CCA and GHM rules. At the recurrent fixed full/full palette, all colors rotate and microscopic period is three. The recurrent support two-cycle swaps both present colors after two steps and hence has microscopic period four. Nonrecurrent supports cannot yield microscopic periodic states. Exhausting the 49 transition pairs proves the cardinality-and-union period criterion and the first-entry clocks. Each prescribed size-k support has sigma_k(a)=sum (-1)^{k-j} binom(k,j)j^a labelled fillings; summing its product by the 49 first-entry classes produces the ten integer formulas and all-parameter identity sum=3^(a+b). Independently reconstructed the 49 palettes, both update maps, GHM weighted first-entry histogram, and sum formula for (a,b)=(1,1),(2,3),(3,4),(5,7),(8,9); no reliance on a finite-size extrapolation.
